EO 6513-I held text (APP heading 'Executive Order 6513-I ... (Amendment Number I)', 1933-12-18): approves Amendment (Number I); does not cancel or replace the approval
EO 6513 held text: amends EO 6433-A (National Emergency Council); unrelated
no held text cites 6275 as an executive order other than the order itself
reasoning: The order is a pure section 3 code approval with one operative clause; the inventory, independent-command check, earlier-end check (EO 6513-I is an amendment, a later event, not an end) and savings treatment are correct, and the mechanism and source are the right ones. But the recorded first_end date and whole_order_end date are 1932-06-14, which contradicts the cited statute ('Approved, June 14, 1935.'), contradicts the claim's own reasoning, and falls before the statute that authorized the order and before the order's own date. A claim whose end date is wrong is rejected even though its reasoning names the right date. Observation (not a defect affecting the verdict): the claim says the census register lists the order with a full date and the President; the authoritative census (IDENTITY_LAYER_PROJECTION_14972.csv) records only the year and no signer, so the full date rests on the WPA list and the APP page record, both of which confirm it.
